messages:
mia: quick check — observed that aborting a streaming generation from Node SDK doesn't stop the server; the connection stays open and tokens keep coming. repro minimal:

mia: ```js
const ac = new AbortController();
const r = await client.chat.completions.create({model:'x',stream:true,signal:ac.signal});
setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),1000);
for await (const chunk of r) console.log(chunk);
```

jonathan: what node version + sdk version? sometimes undici fetch doesnt propagate cancel the same way as browser fetch

mia: node 20.4, @jonathan sdk v0.9.1

ryan: runtime note: server doesn't get a 'client closed' until socket destroyed; abort only cancels client-side iteration unless underlying socket is closed -> server keeps producing

nisha: I can repro locally, saw CPU spike on model worker after abort, looks like kv cache kept alive

mia: possible fix: SDK should actively close response.body (readable stream) and call request.destroy on underlying socket when ac aborts

jonathan: agree. in JS we can call res.body.cancel() and also call fetchAbortController.abort(); but for undici/fetch we might need res.body.getReader()?.cancel() fallback

ryan: for python we should close the response iter (await resp.aclose()) and ensure httpx/urllib3 underlying conn is closed

mia: proposal: add cross-sdk test: start streaming, abort after 200ms, assert server stops producing within 1s and worker memory/cpu returns to baseline

devex-bot: linked issue: https://redwood/issue/INF-4321 (created)

jonathan: I'll PR JS change (res.body.cancel + socket destroy), mia can add the test harness, nisha will add e2e

nisha: yep I'll add e2e test and add a flaky guard

mia: thanks — tagging @ryan for runtime follow-up on server-side early-socket-close handling :thumbsup:

ryan: on it, will add a small handler to mark request aborted and stop generation loop

jonathan: sounds good. assign owners in the issue and let's aim for patch this week :shipit:

mia: cool, will follow up in the issue with small repro and test plan

ryan: ack

nisha: ack :eyes:

jonathan: ack :+1:
